offers_products.reason: Main offering is education delivered by Strayer and Capella universities; software and tuition platform are secondary.

offers_services.reason: Degree and certificate instruction through Strayer University, Capella University and Jack Welch Management Institute is a service.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual working-adult students choose and enroll in Strayer and Capella degree programs.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Employers buy tuition-assistance pricing like Degrees@Work; over 1,000 organizations partner with Capella.

recurring_revenue.reason: Students enroll term after term across multi-year degrees; employers pay ongoing annual fixed-fee tuition programs.

cyclical_demand.reason: Adult education demand tends to hold or rise in downturns, and employer tuition benefits are steady.

big_ticket.reason: Tuition is paid course by course and term by term, in small recurring amounts.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for instruction, coaching and academic support from faculty and staff; education is a people-delivered service.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are individual adult students; employer partners are a secondary channel.

asset_heavy.reason: Mostly online universities with limited campuses; growth needs staff and technology, not heavy plants.

notes: The website text targets employers, but the larger business is the degree-granting universities serving individual students.
